title: Track Guide Autodromo Jose Carlos Pace Moto GR86 iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: use end of wall on right as braking marker, brake to 95% pressure, ease off to first curb
corners.line: cut curb quite a lot, full throttle on curb
corners.mistakes: don't take too much curb as it is raised

corners.label: T3
corners.braking: use road on right as braking marker, brake hard to 90% pressure, ease off to inside curb
corners.line: lean on inside curb, follow as long as possible
corners.mistakes: don't cut curb too much, inside part is raised

corners.label: T6
corners.braking: by the Marshall's post, quick tap to 40%
corners.exit: stay close to right side, use outside curb for turn 7
corners.mistakes: do not touch solid green part

corners.label: T7
corners.exit: hit both curves, walk out to outside for turn 8

corners.label: T8
corners.braking: outside text 'sa Paulo', 90% brake pressure, ease off to inside curb
corners.line: use outside curb, cut a lot

corners.label: T12
corners.line: green and white part of curb

corners.label: T1
corners.line: Cut the curb a little bit on the outside.
corners.exit: Full throttle, use all of the curb on the outside.
corners.mistakes: Cutting the curb too much can unsettle the car.

corners.line: Cut the first, second, and third curb as much as possible.
corners.mistakes: Be smooth with inputs to scrub up as little speed as possible.

general_tips: sit up for exit on turns 1, 2, and 3 for long straight after
breaking zone down to turn five is good overtaking spot
in qualifying, be all the way on the right to open up turn
Take the shortest route to the finish line.
For qualifying, hug the inside wall all the way to the finish line.
In the race, walk out to the right.
